Obviously the code on the shinyapps.io server is unhappy with the Excel file.   I do not see any issues in the log file on the admin interface.

messages.subject: Re: inconsistent file upload of Excel files to shiny--works locally but inconsistent on shinyapps.io
parts:
Update:  I can sometimes get the Excel file to load by saving a failed Excel file, either with a new name or not, either in a new directory or not.   A user told me she tried loading her file and it failed to load and then she tried it again (evidently without touching it) and the file loaded into the Shiny app.

The error appears on uploading the file.   I looked at the shiny::fileInput function (below) but can't see where the error message would be generated.   Clues or solutions welcome!
##shiny::fileinput()
function (inputId, label, multiple = FALSE, accept = NULL, width = NULL) 
{
    restoredValue <- restoreInput(id = inputId, default = NULL)
    if (!is.null(restoredValue) && !is.data.frame(restoredValue)) {
        warning("Restored value for ", inputId, " has incorrect format.")
        restoredValue <- NULL
    }
    if (!is.null(restoredValue)) {
        restoredValue <- toJSON(restoredValue, strict_atomic = FALSE)
    }
    inputTag <- tags$input(id = inputId, name = inputId, type = "file", 
        style = "display: none;", `data-restore` = restoredValue)
    if (multiple) 
        inputTag$attribs$multiple <- "multiple"
    if (length(accept) > 0) 
        inputTag$attribs$accept <- paste(accept, collapse = ",")
    div(class = "form-group shiny-input-container", style = if (!is.null(width)) 
        paste0("width: ", validateCssUnit(width), ";"), label %AND% 
        tags$label(label), div(class = "input-group", tags$label(class = "input-group-btn", 
        span(class = "btn btn-default btn-file", "Browse...", 
            inputTag)), tags$input(type = "text", class = "form-control", 
        placeholder = "No file selected", readonly = "readonly")), 
        tags$div(id = paste(inputId, "_progress", sep = ""), 
            class = "progress progress-striped active shiny-file-input-progress", 
            tags$div(class = "progress-bar")))
}
################################################

messages.author: 877cd740823aa09d
messages.subject: Re: inconsistent file upload of Excel files to shiny--works locally but inconsistent on shinyapps.io  INTERIM FIX
parts:
We think the issue has to do with encoding.   When we force UTF-8 encoding rather than default Windows encoding (e.g. https://help.surveygizmo.com/help/encode-an-excel-file-to-utf-8-or-utf-16) and use Excel 2016 macro to create the files, they all load without the error.   We were previously using Excel 2010; when we forced UTF-8 encoding programmatically in VBA, we still had files fail to load.  However, opening and saving the files (no changes) seemed to resolve the error.

This is not a satisfactory solution as we can't explain why our fix worked.   Will post again if we understand more.

    div(class = "form-group shiny-input-container", style = if (!is.null(width)) 
        paste0("width: ", validateCssUnit(width), ";"), label %AND% 
        tags$label(label), div(class = "input-group", tags$label(class = "input-group-btn", 
        span(class = "btn btn-default btn-file", "Browse...", 
            inputTag)), tags$input(type = "text", class = "form-control", 
        placeholder = "No file selected", readonly = "readonly")), 
        tags$div(id = paste(inputId, "_progress", sep = ""), 
            class = "progress progress-striped active shiny-file-input-progress", 
            tags$div(class = "progress-bar")))
